title: A unification of Euler-Maclaurin and Euler-Boole summation formulas
summary: In this paper, we establish a summation formula associated with the generalized Apostol-Bernoulli functions. This formula unifies the Euler-Maclaurin summation formula, the Euler-Boole summation formula, and the character analogues of these two formulas. We also apply it to obtain the general power sum formula and the special values of Berndt's generalized $L$-function at non-positive integers.
